en: A pale ray that glides the flooded corridors of the Vey, nearly the colour of the salt-glass floors. It has learned that people walk the gallery roofs.
A long-spined urchin from where the deep's cold wells up into the galleries. Rime grows on its spines and doesn't melt.
Nothing to echo yet: no foe has acted.
Small domed tenders that walk the engine's conduits on six legs. They keep its lamps as they always have. They do not fight for it until someone strikes it.

A ringed tower of lamps standing knee-deep in Lowlight's flooded hall, built in the Lit Age to keep the temple bright. Every lamp burns steady and none of them flickers. Its crawlers keep it whole, whatever that costs the lamps.
